novelty.justification: The novelty route is a new measurement relationship: the claim proposes that “the representation of a two-factor stimulus will be approximately the vector sum of single-factor representations” for additive effects, while the residual “tracks the true interaction term” for non-additive effects. Searches using “protein language model hidden representation double-mutant epistasis vector additivity,” “representation arithmetic mutation interaction,” and “scientific foundation model compositional mechanisms” identify the closest work as Protein Language Models Capture Structural and Functional Epistasis in a Zero-Shot Setting (2025), which studies epistasis in PLM-derived output scores, alongside MoCHI (2024), which estimates energetic couplings from DMS data; neither establishes the proposed hidden-state composition-residual diagnostic across additive and interacting cases. Moving from output-level epistasis and standard representation arithmetic to this read-only geometry-versus-scientific-interaction comparison is a substantive multi-step integration and changed unit of analysis, but remains a natural extension of those established ideas rather than a wholly new interpretability paradigm.
